agyos_skill.instructions: The **LinkedIn personal-profile growth engine** — the profile as a landing page, what to post and how often, strategic commenting on target accounts, the golden hour, newsletters/video, and connections vs followers. The agent drafts posts + comment copy and designs the system; a human does the live commenting/connecting; **scheduling-and-queue → WoopSocial** publishes the posts. Complements **linkedin-post-writer** (the single-post craft) and **linkedin-company-pages** (the page). LinkedIn's algorithm rewards **dwell time** (people actually reading) and **early, meaningful comments** — likes barely move distribution, and engagement bait is down-ranked. The feed is structurally tilted to **people, not logos** (personal profiles get ~65% of feed allocation; pages ~1–5%), external **links in the body suppress reach** (put them in the first comment), and posts now have a **long shelf life** via suggested feeds — a good post travels for days or weeks. The cheapest growth lever isn't posting more: it's **thoughtful comments on bigger accounts in your niche**, which put your name in front of their audience daily. And in a feed where ~half the long posts are AI-written, **a specific, lived, first-person POV is the differentiator** — not volume. 1. **brand-profile** — positioning, audience, non-negotiables. 2. **voice-builder** — so posts and comments sound like one credible human. (Depth: `references/the-ladder-framework.md`.) - **L — Landing-page profile:** headline = value proposition (not job title); About opens with the 3 visible lines; Featured = the CTA; Follow-primary once inbound outpaces outbound. Every post's job ends at a profile visit — the profile converts it. → **profile-optimization**. - **A — Author for dwell:** win the "…see more" tap, format for the read, mix text / document carousel / native video / newsletter; **link in the first comment**. → **linkedin-post-writer**. - **D — Deploy strategic comments:** 5–10 substantive comments/day on target accounts in the niche — the afterburner. A comment is content, not a courtesy. → **reply-and-comment-writer**. - **D — Drive the golden hour:** first 60–90 min decides reach; post in the audience window, reply to every comment, comment around your own post time. Max **1 post/day**, 3–5/week.
